strings.큰일은 없었지. 그건 그렇고 그동안 이스트랜드에서 자네가 활약한 소식을: Nothing major has happened here. But I've heard about your exploits in Eastland.
strings.어려움에 빠진 어떤 왕국을 구하고, 그토록 찾던 소녀를 만나 진정한 여신: You saved a kingdom in peril, found the girl you'd searched for so long, and now you're helping her become a true goddess...
You've certainly been through a great deal. Still, I hope you haven't forgotten how to take a breather.
strings.프레이오스엔 그런 말이 있네, 친구. '복잡하게 생각하면 될 일도 되지: We have a saying in Freios, my friend: 'Overthink things, and even what should work out won't.'
strings.그 말, 기억해둘게요. 그런데 무슨 일로 부르셨나요?: I'll remember that. What did you call me for, though?
I was just getting to that.
strings.혹시 마법학원 제레니스라고 들어본 적 있나?: Have you ever heard of Xerenis Magic Academy?
strings.들어본 것 같긴 한데, 정확히는 잘 모르겠어요. 마법을 배우는 학교, 그: I think I've heard the name, but I don't know much about it. A school where people learn magic—that's about it.
strings.(아인스트가 품 안에서 편지를 하나 꺼내 %s에게 건네준다.): (Einst takes a letter from inside his coat and hands it to %s.)
An invitation to the Xerenis academy festival. When I checked, I found you were the recipient.
Why would I get an invitation to an academy festival...
strings.아마도 거기서 자넬 특별한 인물로 생각해서 학원제에 초대한 것 같아. 그: They probably consider you someone special and want you at the festival. They don't send invitations to just anyone.
strings.그동안 무슨 일이 있었던 거지? 일단 의심부터 하고보는군. 편지의 인장은: What have you been through? Your first reaction is suspicion. The seal on the letter really does belong to Xerenis Magic Academy.
Oh, sorry. I just needed a little more information.
strings.그렇군. 그런 거라면 나보다는 무한회랑의 제이드가 많은 이야기를 해줄 거: I see. In that case, Jade of the Infinite Corridor can tell you more than I can.
Right. I heard Jade graduated from the academy. I'll go ask him.
strings.나도 예전에 초대받아 가봤는데, 학원제라는 게 생각보다 재미있더군. 조금: I was invited once myself. The festival was more entertaining than I expected. You look a little worn out. I hope you'll go and unwind.
strings.아, 그리고 학원제가 끝나고 나중에 이곳에 오면 내가 괜찮은 이야기를 하: Oh, and if you come back after the festival, I'll tell you an interesting story. Drop by if that appeals to you.
Hello, Jade. I came to ask for your help.
Judging by the letter in your hand, festival season has come around already.
Oh! You recognized it right away.
strings.편지에 제 모교의 인장이 붙어있으니까요. 아직 뜯지 않으신 것 같은데,: It bears the seal of my alma mater. You haven't opened it yet, have you? Why don't you take a look?
strings.(초대장을 열어 안의 내용을 확인한다.): (You open the invitation and read its contents.)
strings.「신의 심부름꾼이신 모험가님! 당신을 마법학원 제레니스의 학원제 '다프네: 'Adventurer, messenger of the divine! You are invited to Daphne, the festival of Xerenis Magic Academy.'
strings.…라고 적혀있네요. 그런데, 제레니스 마법학원으로 가는 안내 문구가 없네: ...That's what it says. But there aren't any directions to the academy. How am I supposed to get there?
strings.아…. 다른 곳에서 오셨으니 제레니스 마법학원이 어디에 있는지 모르실 수: Ah... You're from elsewhere, so of course you might not know where Xerenis Magic Academy is.
It seems the student council has been discourteous. Allow me to apologize on their behalf.
Oh, it's fine. These things happen.
strings.후배들이 학교를 워낙 유명한 곳이라 생각해서 그랬나 보군요. 그럼 어디로: My juniors must have assumed the academy was so famous that everyone knew it. Then let me tell you how to get there.
strings.제레니스 마법학원은 엘 아노르 평원 서부에서 북서쪽으로 쭉 가다보면 있는: Xerenis Magic Academy is on Xerenis Hill, far to the northwest of western El Anoir Plains.
strings.그것도 언덕 끝 제일 가파른 곳에 건물이 있죠. 제국 초대 황제께서 '학: The buildings stand at the steepest point, right at the top. The Empire's first emperor established it there, saying, 'A school belongs on a hill, of course.'
strings.지금 길드연합이 있는 남부 지역에서 그곳으로는 갈 수 없습니다. 코볼트들: You can't reach it from the southern region where the Guild Union is now. Kobolds were attacking travelers and stealing their belongings so often that the passage had to be closed...
strings.그럼 어떻게 갈 수 있죠?: How can I get there, then?
strings.안전하게 갈 수 있도록 허공해 안쪽에 포탈을 하나 만들었습니다. 그곳을: We've created a portal inside the Void Sea so visitors can travel safely. Take it to Xerenis Hill.
The mages of the Infinite Corridor really are amazing.
It's nothing. We only hope our magic can be useful to everyone.
strings.제이드, 고마워요. 그런데, 제이드는 이번 학원제에 안 가시나요?: Thank you, Jade. Aren't you going to this year's festival?
strings.괜찮습니다. 학원제 초대 기준은 매번 달라서 원한다고 다 갈수는 없으니까: It's all right. The invitation criteria change every time. Not everyone who wants to go can attend.
Sigh. Still, I was invited two years ago, and had such a lovely time...
Come to think of it, I heard Her Majesty wasn't invited this year either.
strings.헛, 실바리아 제국 폐하께서도 못 오실 정도면 기준을 정말 알 수가 없네: Oh! If even the ruler of the Silvaria Empire can't attend, I really don't understand their criteria.
strings.그러니까요, 후후. 가시면 저희 모교의 학원제를 즐겁게 즐겨주시기 바랍니: Exactly. Hehe. Please enjoy my alma mater's festival when you go.
strings.아, 나중에 시간 되신다면 한 번 찾아주셨으면 합니다. 바쁜 일은 아니니: Oh, if you have time later, I'd appreciate a visit. It's nothing urgent, so there's no hurry.
strings.(그러면 제레니스 언덕으로 가볼까…?): (Then shall I head to Xerenis Hill...?)
strings.선배님!! 본관에 있던 아이들하고 선생님하고 초대받은 분들을 대피시켰어요: Soleil! I've evacuated the students, teachers, and guests from the main building.
I've managed to evacuate a fair number from the training hall, too.
strings.저주 때문에 영향을 받은 애들은 제가 어떻게 할 수가 없어요. 제 힘으로: But I can't do anything for the students affected by the curse. It's far beyond my power...
strings.시이나 님, 저도 그건 어쩔 수 없었어요. 일단 한숨 돌리고 방도를 찾아: Lady Shiina, there was nothing I could do for them either. Shall we catch our breath and look for a solution?
strings.네, 선배님. 아, 이런 상황에 이런 말씀 드려야 할지 모르겠는데…. 그: Yes. Um, I don't know if I should bring this up at a time like this... but couldn't you just call me Shiina?
strings.어우, 그건 안 돼요. 제가 어찌 고귀한 이름을 편히 부를 수가 있을까요: Oh, I couldn't. How could I address someone of your noble standing so casually?
Then I suppose I'll have to speak to my sister...
strings.헛, 그러지 마세요!! 이름으로 불러드릴테니 그것만은 제발!!: Oh! Please don't! I'll call you by your name. Just not that, please!
My name is Shiina, Soleil! It's nice to meet you properly.
Thank you for using my name. I wish you'd speak to me more casually, too.
strings.제가 다시 한 번 학교를 둘러볼게요. 아직 대피하지 못한 사람들이 있을: I'll make another round of the school. There may still be people who haven't evacuated...
strings.시이나는 여기 있다가 혹시라도 학원제 때문에 오신 손님이 계시면 돌려보내: Shiina, stay here. If any festival guests arrive, please turn them away.
Yes. In the meantime, I'll keep looking for a way to break this curse.
strings.(시이나가 메모한 것들을 펼쳐 상황을 파악한다.): (Shiina spreads out her notes and reviews the situation.)
strings.이건 학원제 시즌마다 벌어지는 장난이 아냐. 누가 의도적으로 저주를 끼워: This isn't one of the usual festival pranks. Someone seems to have deliberately worked a curse into it... But who...?
The Tower of Sages would have no reason to do this...
strings.저기요? 학생, 제 말 들리나요?: Excuse me? Can you hear me?
strings.까, 깜짝이야! 누, 누구세요…?: Oh! Y-you startled me! Who are you...?
Isn't this Xerenis Magic Academy? I heard there was a festival...
strings.마법학원 제레니스 학원제 '다프네'에 어서 오세요! 헛, 나도 모르게 자: Welcome to Daphne, the Xerenis Magic Academy festival! Oops, the greeting came out automatically.
strings.다행이다. 늦었나 생각했었는데, 딱 맞춰 왔네요!: What a relief. I thought I might be late, but I arrived just in time!
strings.네, 잘 오셨어요! 그런데 어쩌죠? 후우…. 이번 학원제에 사정이 생겨서: Yes, welcome! But what should I do...? Sigh. Something has happened at this year's festival. I'm afraid you won't be able to attend.
I came all this way because you sent an invitation. Is there really no way? Hmm...
strings.(시이나가 %s의 초대장을 보고 짐짓 놀란다.): (Shiina looks rather startled when she sees %s's invitation.)
strings.에, 왜 놀라시는 거죠?: Huh? Why are you so surprised?
strings.죄송해요. 제가 잠시 딴 생각을 했어요. 신의 심부름꾼…이시면 이스트랜드: I'm sorry. My thoughts wandered for a moment. A messenger of the divine... Then you're %s, the hero who saved the Kingdom of Jude in Eastland, aren't you?
Then could you do me a quick favor? It's rather urgent...
Oh, yes. As long as it isn't too difficult.
strings.제레니스 언덕을 오시는 동안 이상한 상황을 많이 보셨을 거예요. 일단,: You must have seen plenty of strange things on your way up Xerenis Hill. For now, could you stop the affected students and rampaging objects from leaving the area?
All right. I'll go right away.
I've taken care of it! Huh, Soleil? What are you doing here...?
It's been a while, %s. Since you have an invitation, I assume you've come for the festival.
strings.그런데 학생이라면…. 빨간 리본의 롱 포니테일 여학생을 말씀하시는 건가요: The student you mentioned... Do you mean the girl with the long ponytail and red ribbon?
strings.네, 맞아요. 그 학생이 제레니스 언덕에 나타난 이상한 물건들이 허공해: Yes, that's her. She asked me to keep the strange objects on Xerenis Hill from getting out through the Void Sea.
strings.시이나 님, 아니, 시이나라면 학생회실에서 뭔가 가져올게 있다면서 잠깐: Lady Shiina—I mean, Shiina—went inside for a moment. She said she needed something from the student council room.
That room has a barrier, at least, so it should be safe. But the other areas...
I'm holding things back somehow, but it won't be easy.
strings.대체 무슨 일이에요? 언덕에 이상한 마법 도구들이 잔뜩이던데…. 마법학: What's going on? The hill is full of strange magical tools... I thought that was normal near a magic academy, but apparently not.
strings.아, 아직 시이나가 말하지 않았나 보네요. 그러면… 저도 말씀드릴 수가: Ah, Shiina hasn't told you yet. In that case... I can't tell you either.
But I've come this far. I can't just leave.
strings.(설마, 이것도 이리스 때문에 일어난 이상 현상인가?): (Could this be another strange phenomenon caused by Iris?)
strings.죄송하지만, 한 번만 같은 일을 부탁드려도 될까요? 이상한 물건들이 허공: I'm sorry, but could I ask you to do the same thing just once more? Please keep those strange objects from escaping through the Void Sea.
strings.그러면 무슨 일이 일어났는지 말해주는 건가요?: Then will you tell me what happened?
All right. I'll make another trip, as you asked.
Shiina should be back by the time you return. We'll explain it together.
Soleil, that person is exactly as my sister described.
Your sister must have told you a great deal.
strings.저희 언니가 보고 느낀 것이 이 세계의 전부는 아니지만, 어느 정도는 알: What my sister has seen and experienced isn't the whole world, but she does know quite a lot.
strings.데고스를 알아보고 절 구해주셨을 뿐만 아니라, 세계를 위협하는 존재들과: They not only saw Degos for what he was and saved me, but have continued fighting beings that threaten the world.
Oh, here they come. We'll have to tell them now...
You're back? I went and cleared the hill again at Soleil's request.
strings.감사드려요. 모험가님. 정식으로 제 소개를 할게요. 저는 마법학원 제레니: Thank you, adventurer. Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Shiina, a second-year student at Xerenis Magic Academy and the student council president.
strings.그러면 %s 님께 제레니스 언덕을 비롯해 학교가 왜 이렇게 됐는지 알려드: Then, %s, let me explain why Xerenis Hill and the academy have ended up like this.
strings.제레니스 마법학원과 더불어 독자적인 마법 교육 권한을 인정받은 '현자의: There is another institution, called the Tower of Sages, which, like Xerenis Magic Academy, is authorized to teach magic independently.
strings.어떤 지역에선 세레스의 신전을 현자의 탑이라고도 부르지만 엄연히 비공식이: In some regions, people call Seres's temple the Tower of Sages too, but that's strictly unofficial. Think of it as a convenient nickname, because so many people gather there.
The real Tower of Sages is on a remote island farther north, toward the continent's interior.
strings.아, 그렇군요. 제가 프레이오스 대륙은 잘 몰라서요. 그럼 이야기를 이어: Oh, I see. I don't know Freios very well. Please, continue.
While the academy serves a broader public, the Tower of Sages studies magic itself. Their work is somewhat more intensive.
strings.서로 경쟁하고 협력하면서 프레이오스의 마법이 상당한 수준이 될 수 있도록: Through competition and cooperation, the two institutions have brought Freios's magic to an impressive level.
strings.그래서 친하다 보니 저희 학원제나 그쪽 대규모 마법 세미나 기간엔 본거지: We've grown close enough that we play pranks on each other's grounds during our festival or their major magic seminars.
I once let a Cerberus from my homeland play freely in the Tower of Sages' front courtyard. That little one was especially fond of Jade...
strings.전설로 내려오는 이야기가 선배님이셨군요. 그 일로 현자의 탑 분들이 일주: So you were behind that legendary incident! I heard no one in the tower could go outside for a week.
strings.현자의 탑에서도 저희 학원제마다 마법 도구들이 아주 잠깐 멋대로 움직이는: The tower usually pranks our festival by making magical tools move around on their own for a little while.
strings.하지만, 이번 학원제는 그 정도가 아니에요. 장난이라 하기엔 저주에 가까: But this year's incident goes far beyond that. It's more a curse than a prank... When we opened a gift box someone sent, a strange energy spread out from it.
strings.학교에 있던 마법 도구들이 멋대로 움직였고, 일부 학생들이 저주의 영향을: The school's magical tools began moving on their own, and some students affected by the curse started destroying the buildings.
strings.그래서 언덕에 있는 이상한 물건들 처리를 모험가님께 부탁한 거예요. 언덕: That's why I asked you to deal with the strange objects on the hill. If they got out, they might travel everywhere through the Void Sea...
strings.시이나가 일단 이 땅에 흐르는 마력을 이용하는 방법을 찾아냈고, 같이 결: Shiina found a way to use the magic flowing through this land, and we raised a barrier together. Luckily, the school had some magic gems.
strings.하지만, 오래 버티지는 못할 거에요. 저주의 힘이 더 커서 보석들의 마력: But we won't be able to hold out for long. The curse is too powerful. There's only so much the gems' magic can do.
strings.게다가 이 저주는 마력이 강한 분들에게 더 영향이 가요. 다른 분들이 대: And the curse has a stronger effect on those with greater magical power. The others evacuated, but our chairman, Professor Zephyros, and our headmistress, Professor Chloris...
strings.그래서 모험가님에 대한 확인이 필요했어요. 이 저주에 영향을 받지 않는: That's why we needed to make sure you really were a special person who wouldn't be affected by this curse.
strings.저와 선배님은 운이 좋게도 그런 자격이 되긴 하지만, 마력으로 학교에 결: Soleil and I are fortunate enough to meet that condition, but all we could manage was putting a magical barrier around the school.
strings.그때 마침 모험가님께서 오신 거에요. 신을 따르는 심부름꾼이자, 특별한: Then you arrived: the messenger of a god, possessing a special power...
strings.(그러고보니 말파스가 나에게 가지고 있는 힘 자체의 구성이 일반적인 인간: (Come to think of it, Malphas said the very composition of my power was different from an ordinary human's.)
strings.흠, 그러면 제가 어떻게 하면 되죠?: Hmm. Then what should I do?
strings.지금 저주의 힘이 강력한 마력을 지닌 이사장님과 교장 선생님께 집중된 거: The curse seems to be concentrating on the chairman and headmistress, both of whom possess tremendous magical power.
I think they chose what they felt was the best way to protect the students... But now they've fused with certain objects and transformed into different shapes.
strings.그나마 다행인 건 그분들의 마력을 분산시키면 그분들도, 다른 학생들도,: The one hopeful thing is that if we disperse their magic, they should return to normal, along with the students and ordinary objects.
strings.제가 어떻게 그분들의 마력을 분산시키죠?: How can I disperse their magic?
strings.특별한 모험가님의 힘이 두 분에게 속한 나쁜 힘을 자연스레 분산시킬 거예: Your special power should naturally disperse the evil power clinging to them.
strings.그렇군요. 그래도 쉽지 않을 것 같은데…. 걱정은 나중에 할게요. 일단: I see. Though it doesn't sound easy... I'll worry about that later. Resolving this comes first.
strings.감사드려요. 그리고 죄송해요. 먼저 마법 수련관에 계신 제피로스 선생님을: Thank you. And I'm sorry. Please start with Professor Zephyros in the Magic Training Hall.
strings.모험가님! 제피로스 선생님께서 원래대로 돌아오셨어요!! 감사드려요!: Adventurer! Professor Zephyros has returned to normal! Thank you!
strings.후우, 다행이네요. 그런데 어떤 분이시기에 그렇게 강력한 마력을 가진 거: Whew, that's a relief. Who exactly is he, to have such powerful magic?
strings.제피로스 선생님은 제국 마법청 소속 요원이세요. 강력한 바람 마법의 소유: Professor Zephyros is an agent of the Imperial Magic Bureau. He's renowned for his powerful wind magic.
strings.마법청에서는 마법으로 인한 분쟁이 일어나지 않도록 견제하기 위해 각 기관: The bureau sends special agents to various institutions to keep magical disputes from breaking out... That's why Professor Zephyros came here.
strings.원래 이사장 자리가 그런 역할이거든요. 그래서 그런가, 교장 선생님하고는: That is the chairman's role, actually. Perhaps that's why there seems to be some friction between him and the headmistress.
So all that's left is the academy's main building? That's where Lady Chloris is?
strings.수련장에 있던 기운이 학교로 모두 몰려갔어요!! 자, 잠깐. 이건 대체: All the energy from the training hall has rushed into the school! W-wait. What is this?
Oh! What should we do...? We won't be able to enter the school like this...
strings.저기, 소레이유…. 이 느낌, 그때와 비슷한 것 같아요. 데고스를 만났을: Soleil... This feeling is like back then. When we encountered Degos... Don't tell me this curse is...
strings.네, %s…. 맞아요. 마계의 기운이에요. 어째서 학교에 마계의 기운이: Yes, %s... It is. The energy of the Demon Realm. Why is it hanging over the school?
strings.서, 선배님. 좋은 방법 없을까요?: S-Soleil, isn't there anything we can do?
strings.방법이 있긴 한데…. 모험가님!!: There is a way, but... Adventurer!
Yes, Soleil. Tell me what to do.
strings.제이드에게 가셔서 임페리얼 게이트를 만드는데 사용했던 보석을 빌려와 주시: Could you go to Jade and borrow a gem he used to make the Imperial Gate?
It can purify or erase traces of the Demon Realm.
strings.모험가님, 부탁드릴게요. 저와 시이나가 마계의 기운을 이 언덕에서 밖으로: Please, adventurer. Shiina and I will do everything we can to keep the demonic energy from spreading beyond this hill.
Yes! I'll be right back. Please be careful...
Shiina, let's check the hill for now. Make sure nothing else happens...
strings.네, 선배님!! 아, 저…, 질문이 있어요. 아니, 이해가 되지 않는 게: Yes, Soleil! Oh, um... I have a question. Or rather, there's something I don't understand.
strings.마계의 기운이 여기에 나타난 이유가 뭘까요? 수 백 년 동안 제레니스 언: Why has demonic energy appeared here? I haven't heard of a demon appearing on Xerenis Hill in hundreds of years.
...This is a secret, but I'll tell you, Shiina.
strings.우리 학교엔 신들의 유물 중 하나가 있어요. 바로 윈디 시드에요. 지금: Our school has one of the gods' relics: the Windy Seed. Someone is disturbing it now.
strings.아, 그래서 클로리스 선생님의 마력이 알 수 없는 힘과 공명하고 있었군요: Oh, that's why Professor Chloris's magic was resonating with an unknown power. I didn't realize it was the relic's power.
strings.선배님, 선생님은 괜찮으시겠죠?: Soleil, the headmistress will be all right, won't she?
strings.괜찮을 거예요. 그러니 너무 걱정하지 마요, 시이나. 모험가님을 믿어봐요: She will be. Don't worry too much, Shiina. Let's trust the adventurer.
strings.어, 학원제에 가신 게 아니었나요?: Oh, weren't you going to the festival?
Something suddenly came up. That's why I hurried back to see you.
strings.(제이드에게 마법학원에서 생긴 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Jade what happened at the magic academy.)
strings.그런 일이 일어나다니…, 제가 바로 찾아보겠습니다. 부속을 해체하면 바로: To think something like that happened... I'll look for it right away. Once the component is dismantled, you can use the gem inside.
Where did it go? I'm certain there was one left...
strings.제이드 님? 혹시 임페리얼 게이트 부속을 찾으시나요?: Jade? Are you looking for the Imperial Gate component?
strings.혹시 어디 있는지 알아요?: Do you know where it is?
I sent it to Archi City for repairs. A messenger has just brought it back.
strings.후우, 다행이군요. 소레이유가 해체 방법을 알고 있으니, 모험가님께서는: Whew, thank goodness. Soleil knows how to dismantle it, so just give it to her.
strings.모교의 일이라 저도 가서 돕고 싶지만, 해야 할 일이 있어서…. 죄송합니: It's my alma mater. I wish I could go help myself, but I have work to do... I'm sorry.
It's all right. Thank you for your help. I'll head straight back to Xerenis.
strings.(임페리얼 게이트 부속인 보석을 소레이유에게 건넨다.): (You hand Soleil the Imperial Gate component containing the gem.)
strings.이게 그 부속…. 제이드가 임페리얼 게이트를 만든다고 했을 때, 사람들은: This is the component... When Jade said he would build an Imperial Gate, everyone was skeptical.
But he did it. Ah, that brought back memories.
Soleil, this should push back the demonic energy somewhat.
Yes. I'll dismantle it right away.
strings.(소레이유의 손에서 흘러나온 기운이 부속을 해체하기 시작한다. 그러자 그: (Energy flows from Soleil's hands and begins taking the component apart. A magic gem radiating a noble light appears within.)
Adventurer, you can enter the main building now.
strings.이제 클로리스 선생님도 쓰러뜨리면, 원래대로 돌아오시는 거죠?: If I defeat Professor Chloris too, she'll return to normal, right?
strings.그렇긴 하지만, 제피로스 님과 융합한 것이 다르기 때문에 더 조심하셔야: Yes, but what she's fused with is different from Professor Zephyros's case. You must be even more careful.
As I told Shiina, our school holds one of the gods' relics, just as Belpha Library once did.
strings.대지에 생명의 힘을 불어넣도록 돕는 고대신들의 유물, 아티팩트에요. 바람: It's an artifact of the ancient gods that helps breathe life into the earth. It travels like the wind and makes the land sprout.
strings.정확히는 어떤 일을 하는지는 알 수 없지만…, 강한 마력을 가지고 있어요: We don't know exactly how it works... but it possesses powerful magic.
strings.(들어본 적이 있는 것 같은데….): (I think I've heard of it before...)
strings.클로리스 선생님이 학생들에게 위험이 가지 않도록 본인이 붙잡고 계실 거예: Professor Chloris is probably holding it back herself to keep the students safe.
strings.마계의 기운 외에 묘한 힘이 이곳에 가득 찼어요. 모험가님께서도 느껴지시: Besides the demonic energy, there's a strange power filling this place. You can feel it too, can't you?
strings.지금 클로리스 선생님의 힘과 윈디 시드의 힘이 만나 서로 공명하고 있어서: That's because Professor Chloris's power and the Windy Seed's are resonating with each other. The seed may be driving her magic out of control...
So this... is Lady Chloris's power.
strings.여제께서도 인정한 '천재 마법사 클로리스'. 마법청에서 일이 있으셔서 학: 'Chloris, the genius mage,' acknowledged even by the empress. Something happened at the Magic Bureau, and she came to the school. Oh, that's not important right now.
If this continues, no one knows what might happen.
strings.모험가님, 다시 한 번 부탁드릴게요. 지금 저희에겐 모험가님의 힘이 필요: Adventurer, please help us once more. We need your power now.
strings.저와 시이나가 마계의 기운을 지우는 작업을 할 테니, 클로리스 님을 부탁: Shiina and I will work on clearing away the demonic energy. Please take care of Lady Chloris.
strings.(알 수 없는 불길함이 온 몸을 스치고 지나간다.): (An inexplicable sense of foreboding brushes through your entire body.)
N-nothing. I must have imagined it.
(...This ominous feeling is like the one I felt from him, inside the divine tree Lapier...)
It's nothing. I'll go to Lady Chloris right away.
strings.(마법학원 본관 안으로 향하는 %s의 발걸음이 빨라진다.): (%s quickens their pace toward the academy's main building.)
Does the adventurer know something...? Um, Shiina...
strings.혹시 시이나의 언니는 모험가님께 이런 일이 생길 것까지 알고 계셨던 걸까: Did your sister know something like this would happen to the adventurer? Is that why she asked us to send the invitation...?
strings.흐음…. 그것까진 잘 모르겠어요. 저도 언니의 전부를 알 수는 없으니까요: Hmm... I don't know that much. Even I don't know everything about my sister.
strings.지금은 저와 선배님이 학교를 지켜야 해요. %s 님께서는 %s 님대로 잘: Right now, you and I need to protect the school. %s will do what %s does best... Soleil, my skills may be lacking, but I hope I can help you.
strings.어우, 시이나의 실력이 부족하다니 말도 안 돼요! 어쨌든! 지금은 집중해: Oh, nonsense! Your skills are hardly lacking, Shiina! Anyway, shall we focus and finish this?
strings.선배님!! 선배님!! 모험가님께서 오셨어요!!: Soleil! Soleil! The adventurer is back!
strings.정말요? 아, 모험가님!! 모험가님!! 괜찮으신가요?: Really? Oh, adventurer! Are you all right?
strings.(시이나와 소레이유가 걱정 가득한 눈빛으로 다가온다.): (Shiina and Soleil approach, their eyes filled with worry.)
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 다행이에요. 나쁜 영향을 받았던 아이들도, 학교도 원래대: I'm all right. What a relief. The affected students and the school seem to be returning to normal.
But is Lady Chloris all right? She vanished so suddenly, it startled me.
strings.클로리스 선생님은 괜찮으세요. 선생님과 융합됐던 윈디 시드도 무사히 제자: Professor Chloris is fine. The Windy Seed that had fused with her has safely returned to its place as well.
strings.원래의 모습으로 돌아와 괜찮은 모습이긴 했지만, 그래도 몸 상태를 확인해: She looked fine once she returned to normal, but we thought she should still have her condition checked. She left for the imperial capital with Professor Zephyros.
strings.잠시만요…, 벌써 준비하고 가셨다고요? 원래 모습으로 돌아온 지 얼마 안: Wait... She already got ready and left? She only just returned to normal.
strings.아니에요, 모험가님. 클로리스 님이 밖으로 나오시고, 학교가 원래의 모습: No, adventurer. It's been two days since Lady Chloris came out and the school returned to normal.
strings.모험가님이 나오시지 않으셔서 저와 선배님이 계속해서 찾았지만, 모험가님의: You didn't come out, so Soleil and I kept searching. But we couldn't find you anywhere.
strings.클로리스 선생님께서 모험가님이 괜찮을 거란 말씀을 하셨지만…, 다행이에요: Professor Chloris said you would be all right... But what a relief. I'm so glad. We were very worried.
strings.…학교 상태를 확인하기 위해 좀 둘러보다 나오긴 했는데, 이틀이 지나다니: ...I did look around a little to check the school's condition before leaving, but two days...?
This is only a guess, but I think the demonic energy tried to move into you.
strings.확실한 건 알 수 없어요. 클로리스 선생님에게서 벗어난 윈디 시드가 마계: I can't be certain. But it's possible if the Windy Seed, freed from Professor Chloris, protected you from that energy.
You probably weren't aware of its protection during that time.
strings.그러고 보니… 전혀 힘든 게 느껴지지 않았어요. 클로리스 님과 싸울 땐: Come to think of it... I didn't feel tired at all. During the fight with Lady Chloris, I felt as though I might die...
strings.모험가님, 다시 한 번 감사드려요. 다음부터는 이런 일이 없도록 철저히: Adventurer, thank you again. We'll have to prepare thoroughly to make sure this never happens again.
strings.저희가 너무 자만하고 있던 건 아니었을까요? 마법학원이 이런 일로 무방비: Were we too confident in ourselves? I never imagined the academy could be left defenseless like this...
Shiina, I'll look for a solution. Don't worry too much.
strings.저기 시이나, 소레이유. 이제 마무리 된 것 같으니 저는 가볼게요. 좀: Shiina, Soleil... It seems everything is settled now, so I'll be going. I need some rest.
strings.타르타로스란 곳의 어떤 분이 저한테 쉬고 있으라 그랬거든요. 그랬는데,: Someone in Tartaros told me to stay there and rest. If she discovers I'm gone, who knows what she'll do...
So I'll explain the school's situation to Jade, then head straight back.
strings.그러시군요. 언제가 될지 모르지만, 몽글몽글 길드의 맛있는 디저트를 대접: I see. I don't know when, but someday I'll treat you to the Mongle Mongle Guild's delicious desserts.
strings.그리고 나중에 시간 되신다면 이곳에 다시 찾아와 주시겠어요? 따로 드릴: And if you have time later, would you visit again? There's something else I'd like to tell you. I'll be here for a while, so come whenever it's convenient.
strings.저기, 모험가님…. 나중에 학원제 초대장을 보내드릴 테니 한 번 더 방문: Um, adventurer... If I send you another festival invitation later, would you come visit us again?
strings.물론이죠. 초대해주시면 꼭 올게요. 물론, 이런 소동이 일어나지 않게 해: Of course. If you invite me, I'll be here. Just make sure there isn't another commotion like this one.
Hehe. There won't be next time. Travel safely.
strings.(이곳에서 느꼈던 불길함이 부디 기분 탓이길…. 시간이 되는 대로, 수련: (I hope that ominous feeling was only my imagination... As soon as I have time, I need to see Iris herself, where she's training.)
strings.돌아오셨군요. 수고하셨습니다. 죄송합니다. 저도 도왔어야 했는데…. 일이: You're back. Thank you for your hard work. I'm sorry. I should have helped too, but something came up...
strings.괜찮아요. 저 말고도 시이나도 소레이유도 있어서 괜찮았어요. 또 제이드의: It's all right. Shiina and Soleil were there with me. And we couldn't have done it without your help, Jade.
strings.(이어서 클로리스를 쓰러뜨리고 유물인 윈디 시드의 영향으로 잠시 시간의: (You go on to explain that after defeating Chloris, the Windy Seed artifact seemed to keep you briefly in a place untouched by time.)
strings.학교에 고대의 유물이 있었다는 건 대충 짐작하고 있었지만, 그런 능력이: I had some idea there was an ancient relic at the school, but I'm surprised it has an ability like that.
strings.걱정되는 게 하나 있습니다. 마계의 기운이 유물이 있는 학교에 나타났다는: One thing worries me. Demonic energy appearing at a school that houses a relic brings back memories of an earlier incident.
strings.화원의 일 말하는 거죠?: You mean what happened in the garden?
strings.네, 맞습니다. 모험가님께서 쓰러뜨린 데고스가 고대의 유물 두 종을 이용: Yes. Degos, whom you defeated, tried to use two ancient relics to connect the Demon Realm to this world...
strings.약간의 구멍이 생겨 그 틈으로 마계의 기운이 들어오고 있긴 합니다. 그래: Some small openings remain, and demonic energy is seeping through them. But the Empire, Guild Union, religious orders, and other groups are continually finding and sealing them.
Still, it's frustrating not knowing how long we'll have to keep doing this.
strings.네, 모험가님께서 모시는 여신께서 좀 더 힘을 갖추셔야겠죠. 그렇게 된다: Yes. The goddess you serve will need to become more powerful. I believe it will resolve naturally once she does.
I thought so... I'll keep working hard, too.
Everyone knows you're always doing your best, adventurer.
strings.네, 고마워요. 그러면 저는 다시 이스트랜드로 가볼게요. 조만간 할 일이: Thank you. Then I'll head back to Eastland. I feel there'll be more work for me soon.
strings.혹시 모험가님, 나중에라도 도울 일이 있으면 말씀해주세요. 저희 무한회랑: If you ever need help, please tell me. We of the Infinite Corridor will spare no effort to assist you.
Thank you. Even the offer means a great deal.
Oh, there's something I forgot to mention.
strings.은빛방패 주점에서 레나 하이렌 경이 모험가님을 기다리고 있습니다. 모험가: Dame Lena Highren is waiting for you at the Silver Shield Tavern. She says she has brought an imperial decree from Her Majesty for you.
strings.잠깐만요?! 실바리아 제국을 다스리시는 황제께서요?: Wait! From the ruler of the Silvaria Empire?
strings.네, 무슨 일인지는 알 수 없습니다만, 그래도 이야기를 들어보셔야 할 것: Yes. I don't know what it's about, but I think you should hear her out.
strings.하여튼, 가볼게요. 고마웠어요, 제이드!: Anyway, I'll go. Thank you, Jade!
Good to see you again, Lena.
I've been meaning to take you to the imperial palace, but circumstances kept getting in the way. I've only made you wait. A great deal has happened in the Empire too. I'm sorry.
Her Majesty also sends her apologies about that.
strings.그리고 여기엔 없지만 거기 이 상황을 보고 있는 당신들 말이야, 오랫동안: And to those of you who aren't here but are watching this: sorry for making you wait so long. Your questions will finally start to be answered.
strings.어라, 레나 씨? 지금 누구한테 이야기하는 거죠?: Huh, Lena? Who are you talking to?
Sigh... Her Majesty told me to look off somewhere and say that when I met you. It was an imperial order. I had no choice.
Oh... Right. Then I suppose it can't be helped.
strings.하여튼, 그동안 여러 가지로 활약하고 있다는 이야기를 들었어. 그토록 찾: Anyway, I've heard you've been busy accomplishing all sorts of things. The girl you were so desperate to find has become a goddess?
And you've become a hero, not only in Mirgandia but even as far away as Eastland...
Impressive. There's a reason Her Majesty keeps an eye on you.
strings.그 정도까진 아니지만요…. 그나저나 제국 여제 폐하의 칙서를 전달한다고: I wouldn't go that far... Anyway, I heard you had an imperial decree to deliver to me.
strings.무한회랑의 마법사에게서 들은 모양이군. 그런데 어쩌지?: You must have heard from the Infinite Corridor mage. But what should I do...?
strings.폐하께서 분명 %s에게 전달하라 이르셨지만, 오늘이 그날이 아니라서 말이: Her Majesty clearly told me to give it to %s, but today isn't the appointed day.
strings.알고 있을지 모르겠지만, 폐하께서는 예지 능력이 있으시다. 다들 알고 있: I don't know if you're aware, but Her Majesty can foresee the future. Everyone knows, so there's little point pretending it's a secret.
strings.폐하의 예지 능력이 대륙에 크고 위험했던 일을 막을 수 있었다. 네가 알: Her foresight has prevented grave dangers to the continent. You may not realize it, but you've already resolved several of those dangers yourself.
She sounds extraordinary, with an ability like that.
strings.칙서는 며칠 뒤에 제대로 전달할테니 그동안 여기서 쉬는 건 어때? 경비는: I'll deliver the decree properly in a few days. Why don't you rest here until then? The Silver Claw will cover your expenses.
strings.여기 맥주가 최고야. 수도의 모든 맥주를 마셔봤지만, 여기만큼 괜찮은 곳: The beer here is the best. I've tried every beer in the capital, and none came close.
strings.저는 타르타로스로 가봐야 해요. 거기 있지 않으면 무슨 일이 일어날지 모: I have to go back to Tartaros. If I'm not there, I don't know what might happen.
Oh, that's already taken care of.
strings.폐하께서 타르타로스로 재미있는 물건을 보내 허락을 받았다고 하셨어. 그리: Her Majesty said she sent an entertaining item to Tartaros and received permission. She also said this matter concerns the goddess, so you would certainly take it on.
What? Am I worth less than some entertaining trinket...?
strings.뭐 어때? 그리고 루맨에서도 네가 잠깐 이곳에 있어도 된다 생각하는 것: What does it matter? And Lumen seems to think it's fine for you to stay here a little while, too.
strings.그런데 이리스와 관계된 일이 대체 뭐죠? 그냥 기다려야 하는 건가요?: But what is this matter concerning Iris? Am I supposed to just wait?
It's Her Majesty's order. Please wait.
I can't find out right now, so I'll wait. It's something I'll have to do anyway...
strings.좋아. 그러면 정확히 이 날, 다시 내 앞으로 와. 그때, 폐하의 칙서를: Good. Then come back to me on this exact day. I'll deliver Her Majesty's decree then. Hmm, I feel as though there was something else to discuss...
Drop by anytime before then. If I remember something, I'll tell you.
strings.알았어요, 레나. 그런데 그동안 여기서 쉬면서 계속 맥주만 마시는 거 아: All right, Lena. But you're not going to spend the whole time resting here and drinking beer, are you?
strings.후우, 이런 술꾼 같으니…. 그럼 마시던 거 마저 드세요. 저도 이제 쉬: Sigh. What a drinker... Go ahead and finish your beer. I'll get some rest too. See you later.
strings.(폐하께서 무슨 생각이신지는 모르겠지만, 조금 기대되는군.): (I don't know what Her Majesty has in mind, but I'm rather looking forward to it.)
Oh, my glass is empty. Sera, another ale, please.
